gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-balinese: Bold and athletic, Tourney stretches its chunky lowercase wide. Noto Sans Balinese follows with open curves and low ascenders, so extended reading stays smooth and unhurried instead of shouting back.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Wiry, stretched-out letters with a stadium-scoreboard punch, all drawn from a single line width in Tourney. Noto Sans Bamum is the sans-serif partner, wide open and plain.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-carian: Neon-tube letters, glowing at one line width. Tourney grabs attention with stretched, bulky forms, while Noto Sans Carian does the quiet work, with terminals spread apart like scissor blades and tidy ascenders.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-chakma: Tourney looks like bent tubing, stretched wide with bulky little letters and no swell anywhere. Noto Sans Chakma takes over the quieter job, packing its lowercase up toward the caps with open, uncrowded s and c shapes.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-chorasmian: Bent-tubing letters, stretched wide and athletic. Noto Sans Chorasmian is the plain sans counterweight, with a large x-height, short ascenders, and curves that stop short instead of closing.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-coptic: Athletic and bold, Tourney turns every corner without any pressure swell. Noto Sans Coptic handles the steady work instead, its middle zone dominating each line while the plain sans shapes stay open.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-deseret: Tourney draws monoline strokes, stretched wide with bulky small letters that feel built for a scoreboard. Noto Sans Deseret is the sturdy counterpart.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Tubular, wire-like letters, wide and athletic: that is Tourney, bulky in the lowercase and cut at one stroke width. Yet Noto Sans Elbasan brings large lowercase forms and terminals that never pinch shut, plain sans and approachable.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: Tourney draws every letter like a fixed-width stencil brush, stretched wide with oversized lowercase. Noto Sans Elymaic sits beneath with open apertures and low ascenders.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-ethiopic: Wide, wiry, athletic letters. Tourney keeps a single monoline skeleton, while Noto Sans Ethiopic is the plain sans with a tall, sturdy lowercase, so a large heading with modest text below looks right.
